description: Nikkei 225 futures (Osaka), continuous series as provided by 225Labo -- day session, night session, calendar-day, and trading-day daily bars, plus 1-minute bars. Owner-downloaded personal-use snapshot, not a live feed.
source: 225Labo N225f_2026.xlsx, owner-downloaded 2026-08-28 under free registration / personal-use license -- see backtest_data/n225f_225labo_20260828/manifest.json
retention: permanent snapshot (owner-downloaded, license-limited to personal use) -- kept as-is, never re-scraped in place; a future refresh would land in a new dated backtest_data/n225f_225labo_<date>/ directory alongside this one, not overwrite it

volume.notes: blank for 1990-2000 (source does not carry it for that period)

night_session_daily.csv.gz.coverage: 2007-09-19..2026-08-28, 4674 rows (night session did not exist before 2007-09)

date.meaning: the calendar date the night session started

date.notes: calendar-day full-session convention -- OHLC spans whichever sessions fall on/after this calendar date, distinct from trading_day_daily.csv.gz's convention below

date.meaning: TRADING-DAY convention: groups the preceding night session with the following day session under one date
date.notes: the convention that matters for continuity across the day/night boundary -- verify which of full_day_daily vs trading_day_daily a downstream script assumes before joining

open.meaning: open of the (preceding night + day) trading-day unit

date.notes: a row's 17:00.. bars belong to the PRECEDING evening's trading day -- e.g. a bar timestamped date=2026-08-28 time=17:05 is the night session that OPENS the trading day dated 2026-08-28, not a continuation of 2026-08-28's day session

time.meaning: clock time within the trading day

quality._unique_key_note: without this, scripts/data_quality.py's auto ts-column pick lands on `date` alone (it appears before `time` in TS_CANDIDATES) -- every one of the ~171 trading days in the file then looks like one repeated 'duplicate' key, purely from having >1 row per day. Verified empty duplicate set under (date, time) -- 205121 rows, 205121 unique (date, time) pairs, 2026-09-05.

known_defects: day_session_daily.csv.gz has NO volume for 1990-2000 (source limitation, not a collection failure)

bars_1min.csv.gz's `date` column uses the TRADING-DAY convention, not the calendar date of the clock time -- a naive groupby(date) on 1-minute bars will put the evening's night-session bars under the FOLLOWING calendar day's trading-day label, which is correct by this dataset's convention but wrong if code assumes date==calendar day of the bar's own timestamp

vs_cash_close comparison (own QC, in manifest.json) found a median 0.179%% / p99 2.135%% / max 4.635%% absolute deviation between this futures series and the TOPIX/Nikkei cash close across 8986 matched days -- expected futures/cash basis, not a defect, but material for anything comparing this series directly to a cash index level
one genuine calendar gap > 10 days: 2019-04-26..2019-05-07 (Golden Week 2019, confirmed genuine per manifest.json qc.calendar_gaps_gt10d)

day_daily_vs_1min_reconstruction QC only checked 170 overlapping days (the 1-minute file's short 2025-12-30..2026-08-28 span) -- exact match on open/close for those 170, not evidence about the other ~8868 days that have no 1-minute counterpart to check against
